description: Rebuild JAY Network CLI Miner to use Puppeteer browser automation with injected Keplr wallet mock, replacing direct API/WebSocket mining approach.
steps: Update package.json: replace ws dependency with @cosmjs/amino, @cosmjs/crypto, @cosmjs/encoding; keep puppeteer, chalk@4, dotenv. Add start script.
Create src/wallet.js - derive wallet address and keys from mnemonic using @cosmjs/amino (HD path m/44'/118'/0'/0/0, bech32 prefix yjay)
Create src/keplr-mock.js - generates injectable JavaScript string for window.keplr mock using wallet info

Create src/browser-miner.js - Puppeteer automation: launch browser, inject Keplr, navigate to mining site, handle security challenge, connect wallet, monitor mining stats via CDP WebSocket interception and DOM polling
Rewrite src/index.js - new entry point with CLI args (--headless=false, --help), banner, mnemonic security warning, launches browser miner
Remove old files: src/miner.js, src/worker.js, src/config.js
acceptance_criteria: src/wallet.js correctly derives yjay-prefixed address from mnemonic
src/keplr-mock.js generates valid injectable script string
src/browser-miner.js launches Puppeteer and injects Keplr mock
Old files (miner.js, worker.js, config.js) are removed
Mnemonic is never logged or displayed
verification: Run npm install and confirm exit code 0
Run node src/index.js --help and confirm it prints usage info

Run node -e "const {deriveWallet} = require('./src/wallet.js'); deriveWallet('abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon about').then(w => { console.log(w.address); if(!w.address.startsWith('yjay')) process.exit(1); })" and confirm yjay prefix

Run node -e "const {createKeplrMockScript} = require('./src/keplr-mock.js'); const s = createKeplrMockScript({address:'yjaytest',pubKey:'aabb',algo:'secp256k1'}); if(!s.includes('window.keplr')) process.exit(1); console.log('OK')"
Run node -e "const {BrowserMiner} = require('./src/browser-miner.js'); console.log(typeof BrowserMiner)" to confirm module loads
findings: npm install required --strict-ssl=false due to SSL cert issue in sandbox. All modules load correctly. Wallet derivation from mnemonic works with yjay prefix. Keplr mock script generates valid injectable code. Browser launches and navigates successfully. Vercel security challenge detection works (60s timeout). CDP WebSocket frame monitoring enabled for mining stat tracking.
